purpose.en: Train elbow flexion with alternating dumbbell curls.

text.zh: 大臂贴住身体，只动小臂
text.en: Keep your upper arms by your sides and move only your forearms

text.zh: 左右交替弯举，下降时继续控制重量
text.en: Alternate arms and keep control of the weight as you lower it.

text.zh: 身体保持稳定，手腕与前臂保持自然对齐
text.en: Keep your body steady and your wrists naturally aligned with your forearms.

commonErrors.zh: 身体前后摆动带起哑铃
commonErrors.en: Rocking the body to lift the dumbbells.
Moving the elbows far forward during the curl.

cautions.zh: 肘：保持大臂靠近身体，控制屈伸，不用身体摆动带起哑铃。
cautions.en: Elbow: keep the upper arms by the body and control the movement without swinging the torso.

cautions.zh: 手腕：握稳可控制的重量，手腕自然对齐前臂，下降时保持控制。
cautions.en: Wrist: use a controllable load, keep the wrist aligned with the forearm, and lower under control.
